name: DeezNutz404 DN404Reflect self-transfer balance inflation
summary: DN404Reflect._transfer() snapshots sender and recipient reflection balances and writes both back without rejecting from == to, so on a self-transfer the recipient credit overwrites the sender debit and the balance grows. The attacker self-transferred repeatedly and sold the unbacked tokens into the WETH pair; copycats repeated it for months.

campaign.selection: Transactions with a DeezNutz 0xb57e8740 ERC-20 Transfer log whose from equals to (a self-transfer), other than the attacker contract 0xd129d8c1's; each also drained WETH from the pair 0x1fb4904b.

notes: Reset is enableTrading() (0x2cf909f2, slot 0x5), one block before the exploit: transfer() reverts for everyone but the owner until tradingEnabled is set, and it had never been set, so it first made the self-transfer path usable (rule 8). The owner's setTaxFee and excludeAccount calls only shape the reflection fee and the pair's accounting; a self-transfer inflates a non-excluded holder either way, so neither resets the age.

Loss is the pair's WETH outflow (loss.mjs) over the anchor, the attacker's three follow-ups and all 612 later self-transfer txs; the anchor alone is 58.658 WETH. The inflated DN taken from the pair is not counted separately, its value being the WETH it was sold for.
